message:
So `getGlyph` calls `makeGlyph` if the glyph is not in the cache. Since this is the first time the font is used, the cache will be empty, so `makeGlyph` will be called.

Now let me check `SplashFTFont::makeGlyph` to confirm it uses `matrix`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/poppler && sed -n '260,300p' splash/SplashFTFont.cc</｜｜DSML｜｜>
